title: Mediterranean Veggie Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy wrap filled with roasted vegetables, perfect for a quick and easy meal. This Mediterranean-inspired dish is a great way to get your daily dose of vegetables.
instructions: 1. Lay the wrap flat on a clean surface.
2. Spread the hummus evenly over the center of the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
3. Arrange the sliced bell pepper, cucumber, tomato, and onion on top of the hummus.
4. Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the vegetables.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
7. Slice in half and serve immediately.
